VHist - Time Range from history array.vi

Owning Palette: History Report & Utility VIs

The VI looks over several DBL histories and returns the oldest and the newest time stamps found.

Click the parameters for more information

 

history array. Array of clusters that contains information on historical data.
time stamps. Array of timestamps for respective elements in history data.
history data. Array of historical values.
max time stamp. Newest timestamp found over all data in the history array.
min time stamp. Oldest timestamp found over all data in the history array.
